identity.real_world_identity_notes: PMR identifies this entry as the 2023 Ford Mustang AU. Official Supercars documentation establishes the Gen3 six-speed manual sequential stick mechanism. Exact gearbox construction, shift technique, and final production wheel hardware remain open.

wheel_rim.notes: Exact real-car wheel details were not established by the reviewed sources.

notes: The reviewed exact-scope sources establish forward gears: 6; shift actuation: sequential stick; shift pattern: sequential.
The reviewed real-car sources do not establish launch technique, running-shift technique, cut and blip behavior or wheel topology; those baseline fields remain unknown.
Project Motor Racing 2.2.1.0 behavior and cockpit values were directly observed and are preserved as simulator overrides where the real baseline is unknown.
Observed live in PMR 2.2.1.0 via guided verification observation pmr.mustang-au.20260915t152203276z-61f82a2a-wheel-correction-2e17ed71 by Jason Kinslow.

Correction superseding pmr-v8-pack-identity-135: On 2026-09-15 Jason Kinslow corrected his description of both PMR AUS V8 Evo wheels to a conventional closed rim with flat top and bottom. Under docs/data-model.md this is d-shaped with open_top no. This is a correction of the original cockpit classification, not a new drive or a change to the observed PMR 2.2.1.0 build. The inspected YTG Gen3 Mustang cockpit photo illustrates this rim topology but does not establish PMR rendering or the authentic baseline for either entry.
